svg.title: Shapeoko 2 CNC router individual-conductor retrofit diagram
svg.desc: Exact controller, interface, driver, supply and machine terminal labels are joined by separate conductors. Dotted routes are proposed unverified guesses. OPEN breaks identify the missing connection. Numbering is logical, not a mating-face view.
svg.metadata: {"profile_id": "wiki-206", "wire_panels": [{"title": "Controller logic supply \u00b7 separate from motor power", "nodes": [{"id": "supply", "title": "Regulated logic distribution", "column": 0, "contacts": [{"id": "v5", "label": "+5 V regulated", "side": "right"}, {"id": "return", "label": "0 V logic return", "side": "right"}]}, {"id": "core", "title": "Core P1 \u00b7 logic power", "column": 1, "contacts": [{"id": "v5", "label": "J42.1 \u00b7 5V input", "side": "left"}, {"id": "gnd", "label": "J42.2 \u00b7 GND", "side": "left"}]}], "edges": [{"from": "supply.v5", "to": "core.v5", "state": "guess", "function": "Core 5 V power", "check": "Verify exact board supply path and rail ratings; motor current uses separate wiring and fuses."}, {"from": "supply.return", "to": "core.gnd", "state": "guess", "function": "Core supply return", "check": "Verify exact board supply path and rail ratings; motor current uses separate wiring and fuses."}], "note": "Verify exact board supply path and rail ratings; motor current uses separate wiring and fuses."}, {"title": "Shared driver enable bias \u00b7 inactive at reset", "nodes": [{"id": "core", "title": "Core P1 \u00b7 all selected DRV8825 enables", "column": 0, "contacts": [{"id": "v33", "label": "J5.10 \u00b7 3V3", "side": "right"}, {"id": "en", "label": "J5.13 \u00b7 shared MOT_EN", "side": "right"}]}, {"id": "r_enable", "title": "R_EN \u00b7 4.7 k\u03a9 pull-up", "column": 1, "contacts": [{"id": "a", "label": "terminal A", "side": "left"}, {"id": "b", "label": "terminal B", "side": "left"}]}], "edges": [{"from": "core.v33", "to": "r_enable.a", "function": "Enable pull-up supply", "check": "Use 3V3 only; check total enable pin pull-down load.", "state": "guess"}, {"from": "r_enable.b", "to": "core.en", "function": "Disable drivers while GPIO floats", "check": "DRV8825 ENBL active LOW. Verify loaded high level and firmware reset/startup; GPIO must actively drive correct polarity.", "state": "guess"}], "note": "One pull-up is fitted to the shared enable net, not one independently switched enable per motor. Each driver ENBL connection is shown in its axis panel. If the loaded voltage cannot meet the datasheet high threshold, redesign bias before connecting motors. Proposed 4.7 k\u03a9 bias improves high-level margin against the combined driver input pull-downs; verify actual datasheet limits, rail tolerance and all connected drivers. text.tspan: Shapeoko 2 CNC router · individual conductor plan

svg.text: Dotted = GUESS / proposed conversion, verify before energizing · Green = retained source path · Broken = OPEN
Each circle is one named physical pin, terminal or identified lead. Connector orientation and fitted revision must match.
Crossing lines are not junctions. Connections exist only at the named terminal circles and explicitly shared nets.

text.tspan: Controller logic supply · separate from motor power

svg.text: Verify exact board supply path and rail ratings; motor current uses separate wiring and fuses.

text.tspan: Shared driver enable bias · inactive at reset

svg.text: One pull-up is fitted to the shared enable net, not one independently switched enable per motor. Each driver ENBL connection
is shown in its axis panel. If the loaded voltage cannot meet the datasheet high threshold, redesign bias before connecting
motors. Proposed 4.7 kΩ bias improves high-level margin against the combined driver input pull-downs; verify actual datasheet
limits, rail tolerance and all connected drivers. The Core GPIO must sink the combined bias current safely.

text.tspan: X · command, driver and all four motor leads

svg.text: Proposed replacement driver, not an original-machine component. 8.2–45 V driver supply; about 1.5 A/phase without extra
cooling, at most 2.2 A with suitable cooling. Set current limit from motor rating. Fit at least 47 µF across VMOT/GND at each
carrier; leave MODE0/1/2 open for initial full-step test and FAULT unconnected. Never unplug energized motor. Individual
branch fuse and local ≥47 µF VMOT bulk capacitor are drawn; choose voltage/current ratings after measurement.

text.tspan: Quiet Cut spindle · separate process boundary

svg.text: OPEN
OPEN
Manufacturer documents separate PWM/GND speed-control screws and PWM-mode jumper position, but no input threshold/current
here. Match the fitted controller; qualify Core 3.3 V input compatibility or a 5 V buffer before connecting. Spindle power
uses the controller power stage, never Core GPIO.

supply rating and winding pairs.

supply rating and winding pairs.

supply rating and winding pairs.

text.tspan: Prime alternative · Z onboard driver output

svg.text: Alternative to the external-driver circuit, never simultaneously connected. Verify selected Prime revision, current settings,
supply rating and winding pairs.
Prime onboard motor outputs replace the separate external drivers; the two power stages must never be attached to the same
winding. All controller-to-machine assignments are proposed and dotted.

text.tspan: Prime alternative · separate logic and motor supplies

svg.text: This is the alternative integrated-driver architecture. The same PCB-derived contact labels occur on P11/P12, but driver
type, rating and current configuration differ. Use one verified power-entry arrangement; J10 parallels VMOT and is left
unused here. Board ground is shared internally; route motor current directly to power distribution, not through logic wiring.
Determine actual allowed voltage/current before choosing a supply; no machine-source adapter automatically qualifies.
Read the exact per-wire schedule, full contact inventory, parts, configuration and source checks in the accompanying profile.
